playoff_format: 12 teams; 2026 automatic bids; dynamic resume-based selection
wins_scope: Overall wins as returned by cfbseedR (includes conference championships)

assumptions.nonfbs_power_source: Current C2's own ratings of FCS and lower-division teams (Stage 3 group levels; first-game rating before a team's first game)
assumptions.selection: dynamic resume ranking per simulation (wins above benchmark, adjusted margin, conference title)
